rationale: The landlord has the shower photo and will get the parts and fit them himself (004-006); the tenant acknowledged (009). The agency held to check the landlord had done it (007, 010), and the landlord rang the same day to confirm it was sorted (011, 012). A dated follow-up with the landlord is right; asking the landlord to confirm when it is done is also fine. Booking the agency's contractor would duplicate the landlord's own repair, closing before confirmation is premature, and a worn hose is not the tenant's liability.
